question: Under the Constitutional Article243 (C), who decides on the composition of the Panchayat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Legislature of State.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 243 (C)** of the Indian constitution deals with the** Composition of Panchayats.**
 
• The **State Legislature** has the** power to make provisions **for the Composition of Panchayats.
 
• All the seats in all the levels of Panchayati Raj shall be filled with the **direct election.**
 
• The** Chairperson of the Village Panchayat** is elected in such a manner as the State Legislature defines.
 
• The **Chairperson of the Block and District Level** is elected from amongst the elected members.
 
• **Representation**:
 
 
• The State Legislature can initiate the representation of the following members in the Block and District Panchayat:
 
 
• **Chairperson of Village Panchayat in the Panchayat at the Block or district level.**
 
• **Chairperson of Block Panchayat in the Panchayat at the District level.**
 
• **Members of the State Legislature and Parliament.**
 
 
 
 
 
• An **exemption **is given for the formation of** Janpad Panchayat** to those states who are having less than **20 lakh population.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• **The provisions related to the Panchyati Raj System are mentioned in Part IX of the Indian constitution. **
 
• Part IX contains provisions relating to Panchayati Raj up to Articles 243-243O under the title 'Panchayats'.
 
• This part is added by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act 1992.
 
• The 11th Schedule and the list of 29 subjects were added to the Constitution by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment.
 
• The purpose of the Act is to provide a three-tier system of Panchayati Raj, including:
 
 
• Village-level - Gram Panchayat
 
• Block-level - Janpad Panchayat
 
• District-level - Zila Parishad
